name: pgvector_policy_rag_thin_wrapper
description: A documented reference shape for pgvector plus an application-side policy engine and a RAG citation library.

failure_rationale.determinism: The reference does not expose byte-identical canonical pack and determinism-hash commitments across process boundaries.
failure_rationale.plan_binding: The reference applies policy as an application-side filter rather than as fail-closed plan algebra with independently checkable enforcement evidence.
failure_rationale.receipt_verifiability: The reference does not emit accountability_receipt.v1 roots that a standalone verifier can check without trusting the serving stack.
